title: Author typed engineering relationships
description: Create, revise, or remove one authoritative relationship fact in a selected candidate model and expose consistent endpoint views. Resolving identities and assessing the whole model are separate shared behaviors.
inputs: Selected candidate model state and governing relationship profile.
Requested relationship operation, type, and endpoint identities.
outputs: Accepted relationship change with its authoritative fact and selected state.
Derived forward and reverse views or a diagnostic for a rejected or incomplete request.
behavior: Interpret the requested type and endpoints using the selected profile and uniquely resolved entities.
Use the profile-selected authoritative containment representation for requirement parents and the selected authoritative representation for cross-domain facts.
Check declared endpoint types and cardinalities before accepting the proposed fact.
Derive opposite endpoint views from the accepted fact and reconcile them when it changes or is removed.
Preserve previous-state meanings and do not treat relationship authorship as approval or satisfaction.

failure_behavior.condition: An endpoint is missing or ambiguous, or a type is unknown.
failure_behavior.outcome: Reject the proposal with the unresolved endpoint or unsupported type identified.

failure_behavior.condition: The proposed fact violates declared parentage or cardinality.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the specific conflict without accepting a second authoritative representation.

failure_behavior.condition: The operation cannot complete or the selected candidate changed.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report failure or a changed selection; do not claim a complete accepted relationship change.

sources.basis: IR-002 / SR-008 requires one authored relationship fact and consistent inverse views; SR-013 constrains the governing mechanical checks.

Propose MOD-002 as the single accountable architectural responsibility for the existing behavior. This allocation preserves the Function definition and does not establish implementation or completed interface/AR coverage outside the IR-001 pilot.
